name: Direct probability integral method (DPIM)
definition_zh: 文中直接对随机输入的概率空间进行积分以获得响应概率信息的方法。
usage_overview: 利用代表点的计算响应及其概率权重求取响应概率分布，将随机输入下的响应计算用于极值分布、动力可靠度及累积沉降的概率评估；在概率密度重构中可采用高斯光滑。

complete_examples.text: Furthermore, the direct probability integral method (DPIM) is introduced to implement the uncertainty quantification and reliability assessment of cumulative settle ment, especially spatial distribution, 3D-probability density function and the variation of reliability index with load cycles.

To overcome this bottleneck, the probability density evolution method (PDEM) (Chen and Li 2005; Chen, Yang, and Li 2016) and direct probability integral method (DPIM) (Chen and Yang 2019, 2021) were proposed to character the probability transmission from the random input space to the response output of the system based on the H. LIU ET AL. principle of probability conservation, which possesses the great accuracy in the case of the limited number of samples.
A new direct probability integral method (DPIM) is introduced to achieve the stochastic analysis and reliability assessment of the train-ballasted track–bridge interaction (TTBI) system.

To overcome the bottleneck of PDEM, Yang and Chen [27,28] recently derived the probability density integral equation (PDIE) of stochastic systems, and developed corresponding the direct probability integral method (DPIM) to solve PDIE, their methodology has been proven to be highly accurate and efficient in uncertainty quantification and reliability evaluation of some simple stochastic static and dynamic systems.
